sections.heading: 口述输入
body: 用语音写字，要的是在每个应用里都能用、文字直接落在光标处的工具。macOS 听写能做到，适合短内容，见 [Mac 怎么语音输入](how-to-voice-type-mac)。[Superwhisper](superwhisper-alternative)、[VoiceInk](voiceink-alternative)、[Wispr Flow](wispr-flow-alternative)、我们做的 TypeAloud这类第三方应用，在此基础上加了历史记录、AI 整理或本地模型。

sections.heading: 录音转写
body: 采访、讲座、会议录音，需要的是批量导入、区分说话人、导出字幕或文档。这方面 MacWhisper 最专业，和 Superwhisper 的区别见 [Superwhisper 对比 MacWhisper](superwhisper-vs-macwhisper)。

sections.heading: 两件事都能离线
body: 在 Apple Silicon Mac 上，这两件事都可以不上传音频完成。在意隐私就选本地模型，见 [Mac 离线语音输入](offline-dictation-mac)。

faq.q: Mac 上最好用的免费语音转文字是什么？
faq.a: 口述输入的话，macOS 听写系统自带；Superwhisper 免费版、Spokenly 和 TypeAloud 是免费应用。转写文件的话，MacWhisper 免费版能做基础转写。

faq.q: 听写应用能转写音频文件吗？
faq.a: 有的可以：Superwhisper 需要 Pro，MacWhisper 本来就是做这个的。macOS 听写和 TypeAloud 等只接受现场说话。

faq.q: Mac 语音转文字支持中文吗？
faq.a: 支持。macOS 听写支持普通话，Qwen3-ASR 这类中文训练的模型还能处理中英混说。

faq.q: Mac 语音转文字需要联网吗？
faq.a: 不一定。macOS 听写对支持的语言可以在设备上处理，本地应用也能离线运行。见 [Mac 离线语音输入](offline-dictation-mac)。

en.title: Offline dictation on Mac: your options, and how to check — TypeAloud
en.description: Ways to dictate on a Mac without an internet connection: macOS Dictation on device, Voice Control and local dictation apps, with how to confirm nothing is uploaded.
heading: Offline dictation on a Mac:
what works without internet.
en.intro: Dictating offline means the speech-to-text model runs on your Mac instead of a server. It works on a plane, on a train and on networks that block cloud services, and your audio is not uploaded. A Mac can do it out of the box for some languages, and several apps extend it. Here are the options and how to check them.

sections.heading: macOS Dictation, on device
body: On recent Macs, built-in Dictation can process general text on the device for supported languages. Open System Settings > Keyboard and look at the Dictation section: it says whether dictation is processed on your device and not sent to Apple's servers.

On-device Dictation has the same limits as usual: one language at a time, it ends after 30 seconds without speech, and it keeps no history. See [how to voice type on a Mac](how-to-voice-type-mac) for setup.

sections.heading: Voice Control
body: Voice Control, in System Settings > Accessibility, also runs on the Mac once its language files are downloaded. It is built for controlling the whole computer by voice, and it replaces Dictation while it is on.

sections.heading: Local dictation apps
body: Third-party apps download a speech model once and run it on your Mac. Model files range from under 100 MB for the smallest Whisper models to a few GB for the largest; bigger models are usually more accurate and slower.

Options include [VoiceInk](voiceink-alternative) (many local models including SenseVoice, paid licence), the free tier of [Superwhisper](superwhisper-alternative) (local Whisper), [Spokenly](spokenly-alternative) (local models free), Handy (open source, several models) and TypeAloud, which we make (free, open source, Qwen3-ASR). For recordings rather than dictation, [MacWhisper](macwhisper-alternative) transcribes files locally.

sections.heading: How to check it really is offline
body: After the model has downloaded, disconnect from every network, Wi-Fi and Ethernet, and dictate a few sentences. If it works, transcription happens on your Mac. That proves offline capability; whether an app uploads anything once you reconnect is a question for its privacy policy, its source code if it has any, or a network monitor. More in [private dictation](private-dictation).

sections.heading: What you give up
body: Cloud apps such as [Wispr Flow](wispr-flow-alternative) and [Typeless](typeless-alternative) run large models and an AI rewriting pass on their servers. Some local apps can also clean up text on the Mac, such as VoiceInk Refine or Handy with Apple Intelligence or a local model; otherwise you get a verbatim transcript. Local apps need disk space for the model and are fastest on Apple Silicon. Accuracy depends on the model and the language: Whisper-based models are strong in English but [struggle when Chinese and English mix](whisper-chinese-english).

faq.q: Does Mac dictation work without internet?
faq.a: For supported languages on recent Macs, yes: Keyboard settings show whether general dictation is processed on your device.

faq.q: How big are offline speech models?
faq.a: From under 100 MB for tiny Whisper models to a few GB for large ones. Qwen3-ASR 0.6B is about 1 GB.

faq.q: Is offline dictation free?
faq.a: macOS Dictation is free. Among apps, some are free (Superwhisper's free tier, Spokenly's local models, Handy, TypeAloud) and some charge a one-time licence (VoiceInk).

faq.q: Which offline option is best for Chinese?
faq.a: Look for a model trained on a lot of Chinese, such as Qwen3-ASR or SenseVoice, especially if you mix in English, and test with your own sentences. See [mixed Chinese–English dictation](chinese-english-dictation).

zh.title: Mac 离线语音输入：有哪些方案，怎么确认真的离线 — TypeAloud
zh.description: 不联网也能在 Mac 上语音输入的几种办法：系统听写的设备端处理、语音控制、本地听写应用，以及怎么确认录音没有上传。
heading: Mac 离线语音输入：
不联网也能用的几种办法。
zh.intro: 离线语音输入，指的是语音识别模型在你的 Mac 上运行，而不是在服务器上。飞机上、高铁上、屏蔽了云服务的网络里都能用，录音也不会上传。Mac 自带的功能对部分语言就能做到，另外还有一些应用可以补上它的不足。下面逐一说明，并讲怎么自己验证。

sections.heading: 系统听写的设备端处理
body: 在较新的 Mac 上，系统自带的听写对支持的语言可以在设备上处理。打开“系统设置 > 键盘”，看“听写”那一栏：它会说明一般听写是否在你的设备上处理、不发送到 Apple 的服务器。
设备端听写的限制和平时一样：一次只用一种语言，30 秒没检测到语音就结束，也不保留记录。设置方法见 [Mac 怎么语音输入](how-to-voice-type-mac)。

sections.heading: 语音控制
body: “系统设置 > 辅助功能”里的语音控制，在下载语言文件后也在本机运行。它是为用声音操作整台电脑设计的，开着的时候会替代普通听写。

sections.heading: 本地听写应用
body: 第三方应用会下载一次语音模型，然后在你的 Mac 上运行。模型文件从最小的 Whisper 模型不到 100 MB，到最大的几个 GB 不等；模型越大通常越准，也越慢。

可选的有 [VoiceInk](voiceink-alternative)（本地模型多，包括 SenseVoice，付费买断）、[Superwhisper](superwhisper-alternative) 的免费版（本地 Whisper）、[Spokenly](spokenly-alternative)（本地模型免费）、Handy（开源，多种模型），以及我们做的 TypeAloud（免费开源，用 Qwen3-ASR）。如果要转写的是录音文件而不是实时听写，[MacWhisper](macwhisper-alternative) 可以在本地转写文件。

sections.heading: 怎么确认真的离线
body: 模型下载完后，断开所有网络（Wi-Fi 和有线都断），说几句话试试。能用，说明转写在你的 Mac 上完成。这只能证明它能离线工作；重新联网后会不会上传东西，要看它的隐私政策、有没有公开的源代码，或者用网络监控工具查。详见[不上传录音的语音输入](private-dictation)。

sections.heading: 离线要放弃什么
body: [Wispr Flow](wispr-flow-alternative)、[Typeless](typeless-alternative) 这类云端应用在服务器上跑大模型，还会用 AI 改写。有些本地应用也能在本机整理文字，比如 VoiceInk Refine，或者用 Apple Intelligence、本地模型的 Handy；否则得到的就是逐字转写。本地应用需要磁盘空间放模型，在 Apple Silicon 上最快。准确度取决于模型和语言：基于 Whisper 的模型英文很强，但[中英混说时容易出错](whisper-chinese-english)。

faq.q: Mac 听写不联网能用吗？
faq.a: 在较新的 Mac 上，支持的语言可以。“键盘”设置里会显示一般听写是否在设备上处理。

faq.q: 离线语音模型有多大？
faq.a: 从最小的 Whisper 模型不到 100 MB，到大模型的几个 GB。Qwen3-ASR 0.6B 约 1 GB。

faq.q: 离线语音输入要花钱吗？
faq.a: 系统听写免费。应用里，有免费的（Superwhisper 免费版、Spokenly 本地模型、Handy、TypeAloud），也有一次性买断的（VoiceInk）。

faq.q: 中文用哪个离线方案好？
faq.a: 找用大量中文训练的模型，比如 Qwen3-ASR 或 SenseVoice，尤其是经常夹英文的时候，再用你自己的句子测一测。详见[中英混合语音输入](chinese-english-dictation)。

en.title: Mixed Chinese–English dictation: why it is hard and what works — TypeAloud
en.description: Why dictation tools garble sentences that mix Chinese and English, which tools handle it, and how to speak so mixed sentences come out right.
heading: Dictating Chinese and English
in the same sentence.
en.intro: "这个 bug 是因为 API 返回的 status code 不对": sentences like this are normal for bilingual people, and they are exactly where many dictation tools fail. This guide covers why, which kinds of tools handle it, and a few speaking habits that help whatever you use.

sections.heading: Why mixed sentences break
body: Many engines work in one language at a time. macOS Dictation uses the language you have selected, and you switch it by hand. Standard Whisper decides on a language from the first 30 seconds and transcribes the rest in it ([details](whisper-chinese-english)). English words inside Chinese grammar then come out as Chinese-character approximations, get dropped, or the whole sentence turns into English.

sections.heading: Tools that handle it
body: Models trained heavily on Chinese speech detect the language as they go. Qwen3-ASR and SenseVoice are two you can run locally on a Mac, through apps such as Handy or TypeAloud, which we make.

Chinese input methods with cloud voice input, such as [WeChat Input](wechat-input-alternative) and [Doubao Input](doubao-input-alternative), also advertise mixed Chinese and English. Cloud apps like [Wispr Flow](wispr-flow-alternative) and [Typeless](typeless-alternative) list over 100 languages; how they handle switching within a sentence is worth testing with your own speech.

sections.heading: How to speak so it comes out right
body: Say English terms as whole words at your normal pace, without slowing down or pausing in the middle of a term. Say acronyms the way you usually do, as letters ("API") or as a word ("SaaS").
Add the names and terms you use often to the tool's dictionary or replacement list if it has one. Product names, colleagues' names and internal project names are the most common errors.

sections.heading: Test with your own sentences
body: Before settling on a tool, dictate five sentences you actually say at work, such as "把这个 PR merge 到 main 之前先跑一下 unit test". Count what you would have to fix. That tells you more than any spec sheet.

faq.q: Can macOS Dictation handle mixed Chinese and English?
faq.a: It transcribes in one selected language at a time. You can switch languages while dictating, but not within a sentence.

faq.q: Why does Whisper write English words in Chinese characters?
faq.a: It settles on one language for the recording. See [Whisper and mixed Chinese–English](whisper-chinese-english) for the cause and workarounds.

faq.q: Local or cloud for mixed speech?
faq.a: Both can work. Local Chinese-trained models keep audio on your Mac; cloud input methods and apps add AI rewriting. Test both with your own sentences.

faq.q: Will proper nouns come out right?
faq.a: Not always, with any tool. A dictionary or replacement list fixes the ones you use repeatedly.

zh.title: 中英混合语音输入：为什么难，用什么工具，怎么说更准 — TypeAloud
zh.description: 为什么语音输入工具常把中英夹杂的句子写错，哪些工具能处理，以及怎么说能让混说的句子转写得更准。
heading: 一句话里中英混说，
怎么让语音输入写对。
zh.intro: “这个 bug 是因为 API 返回的 status code 不对”，这样的句子对很多人来说再平常不过，却正是不少语音输入工具出错的地方。这篇讲清楚原因、哪类工具能处理，以及不管用什么工具都有帮助的几个说话习惯。

sections.heading: 混说的句子为什么容易错
body: 很多识别引擎一次只用一种语言。macOS 听写按你选定的语言转写，切换要手动。标准的 Whisper 会根据开头 30 秒定一种语言，后面都按它转写（[详细原因](whisper-chinese-english)）。于是中文语法里的英文词会被写成发音相近的汉字、被吞掉，或者整句变成英文。

sections.heading: 能处理混说的工具
body: 大量用中文语音训练的模型，会边听边判断语言。Qwen3-ASR 和 SenseVoice 是两个能在 Mac 上本地运行的例子，可以通过 Handy，或者我们做的 TypeAloud 这类应用来用。

带云端语音输入的中文输入法，比如[微信输入法](wechat-input-alternative)和[豆包输入法](doubao-input-alternative)，也宣传支持中英混说。[Wispr Flow](wispr-flow-alternative)、[Typeless](typeless-alternative) 这类云端应用列出了 100 多种语言，句内切换的效果值得用你自己的话测一测。

sections.heading: 怎么说更容易写对
body: 英文词按平时的语速整个说出来，别放慢，也别在一个词中间停顿。缩写按你习惯的读法说，按字母读（“API”）或者当一个词读（“SaaS”）都行。
如果工具有词典或替换列表，把常用的名字和术语加进去。产品名、同事的名字和内部项目名，是最常出错的几类。

sections.heading: 用你自己的句子测
body: 定下用哪个工具之前，把五句你工作中真会说的话念给它听，比如“把这个 PR merge 到 main 之前先跑一下 unit test”，数一数要改几处。这比任何参数表都有参考价值。

faq.q: macOS 自带听写能中英混说吗？
faq.a: 它一次按一种选定的语言转写。听写过程中可以切换语言，但做不到一句话里自动切换。

faq.q: Whisper 为什么把英文写成汉字？
faq.a: 它给整段录音定了一种语言。原因和解决办法见 [Whisper 中英混合识别不准](whisper-chinese-english)。

faq.q: 混说用本地还是云端？
faq.a: 都可以。本地的中文模型让录音留在 Mac 上；云端输入法和应用多了 AI 改写。最好用自己的句子两边都测一下。

faq.q: 专有名词能写对吗？
faq.a: 任何工具都不能保证。词典或替换列表能解决你反复用到的那些。
